lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A discernible grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible, organized into at least five distinct vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the primary circular blobs, creating a structured lattice or grid-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light reflectance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, elongated, low-luminance objects (consistent with remoras) trailing the posterior edge of the pectoral fin and the ventral margin.
